reason: An AI-agent skill that analyzes an existing project and automates generation of development conventions, documentation structure, CI configuration, testing guidance, and related project files.

summaries.zh: 扫描项目结构与依赖，并自动生成 AGENTS.md、文档骨架、CI 配置和测试规范等 AI 开发基础文件。
summaries.en: Scans a project's structure and dependencies, then generates AI development guidance, documentation scaffolding, CI configuration, and testing policies.

capabilities: infers project structure and technology choices
writes AGENTS.md and other IDE instruction files
generates CI configuration and testing policies
creates or updates project configuration files
may use web search for unknown dependencies
